paragraphs.source_en: Sakuzō hurried forward, took off his clothes, and covered Genzaburō with them. For some reason, he pressed his palms together and began to pray: “Namu Amida Butsu… Namu Ami…”

units.source_en: Sakuzō hurried forward, took off his clothes, and covered Genzaburō with them. For some reason, he pressed his palms together and began to pray: “Namu Amida Butsu… Namu Ami…”
units.source_zh: 作藏慌忙走上前去，脱下衣服盖在源三郎的身上，不知为何，他双手合十祈祷起来：“南无阿弥陀佛……南无阿弥……”

paragraphs.source_zh: 作藏慌忙走上前去，脱下衣服盖在源三郎的身上，不知为何，他双手合十祈祷起来：“南无阿弥陀佛……南无阿弥……”

paragraphs.source_en: Only the raging wind roared, blowing mercilessly through the single air vent.

paragraphs.source_en: The next day, hope rose once more in Genzaburō’s heart. He had not the slightest wish to serve as an envoy, but the enemy kept pressing him. Ieyasu had given his word: he would surely come to rescue him! At the final moment of his life, that alone was the greatest satisfaction he could have known. Thus, he no longer cared whether he lived to see Ieyasu; he wished only to show the enemy once more the unyielding strength of his life.

units.source_en: The next day, hope rose once more in Genzaburō’s heart.
units.source_zh: 翌日，源三郎又生出希望。

units.source_en: He had not the slightest wish to serve as an envoy, but the enemy kept pressing him.
units.source_zh: 他丝毫没有出使之愿，但敌人在催促他。

units.source_en: Ieyasu had given his word: he would surely come to rescue him!
units.source_zh: 家康曾说过一句话：一定会来搭救他！

units.source_zh: 因此，他已不在意能否活着见到家康，而愿向敌人再次展示自己生命的坚毅。

paragraphs.source_zh: 翌日，源三郎又生出希望。他丝毫没有出使之愿，但敌人在催促他。家康曾说过一句话：一定会来搭救他！这在他生命的最后时刻，已经是最大的满足了。因此，他已不在意能否活着见到家康，而愿向敌人再次展示自己生命的坚毅。

paragraphs.source_en: If Nagura Gentarō came to the cell to plead with him, it meant the tide of victory and defeat was already clear: unless the enemy sent him as an envoy, they could no longer avert the destruction of their entire force. They will surely come and plead with me again—but who will it be this time? Here in this place, Genzaburō fought his final battle against each enemy commander in turn. He felt supremely happy: war, he now knew, did not belong only to the battlefield…

units.source_en: If Nagura Gentarō came to the cell to plead with him, it meant the tide of victory and defeat was already clear: unless the enemy sent him as an envoy, they could no longer avert the destruction of their entire force.

ja.t: れるすべがないということだった。

units.source_zh: 名仓源太郎若到牢房来求他，说明胜败之势已经分明，敌人除了让他出使之外，已经无法避免全军覆灭了。

units.source_en: They will surely come and plead with me again—but who will it be this time? Here in this place, Genzaburō fought his final battle against each enemy commander in turn. He felt supremely happy: war, he now knew, did not belong only to the battlefield…

ja.t: だけにあるのではなかったのだ……。

units.source_zh: 一定还会再来求我的，却不知这次又会是谁呢——源三郎在这里和敌军将领一一展开最后的决战，他感到无比幸福，原来战争不仅属于战场……

paragraphs.source_zh: 名仓源太郎若到牢房来求他，说明胜败之势已经分明，敌人除了让他出使之外，已经无法避免全军覆灭了。一定还会再来求我的，却不知这次又会是谁呢——源三郎在这里和敌军将领一一展开最后的决战，他感到无比幸福，原来战争不仅属于战场……

paragraphs.source_en: He would forge a will as hard as iron and stone and never yield to the enemy’s threats or enticements. Pride in such victories gave him greater confidence and a deeper sense of achievement with every encounter. This was no hollow sermon, but the mark of a life that Ōkōchi Genzaburō had inscribed through the strength of his will. He would transcend every human weakness and make his will shine forever, like crystal.

units.source_en: He would forge a will as hard as iron and stone and never yield to the enemy’s threats or enticements.
units.source_zh: 铸造起铁石般的意志，决不屈服于敌人的威逼利诱。

units.source_en: Pride in such victories gave him greater confidence and a deeper sense of achievement with every encounter.
units.source_zh: 这种胜利的自豪，使他越战越有信心，越战越有成就感。

units.source_en: This was no hollow sermon, but the mark of a life that Ōkōchi Genzaburō had inscribed through the strength of his will.
units.source_zh: 这决不是空洞的说教，而是大河内源三郎用坚强的意志留下的生命痕迹。

units.source_en: He would transcend every human weakness and make his will shine forever, like crystal.
units.source_zh: 他要超越人的一切弱点，使自己的意志如水晶一样，永远闪闪发光。

paragraphs.source_zh: 铸造起铁石般的意志，决不屈服于敌人的威逼利诱。这种胜利的自豪，使他越战越有信心，越战越有成就感。这决不是空洞的说教，而是大河内源三郎用坚强的意志留下的生命痕迹。他要超越人的一切弱点，使自己的意志如水晶一样，永远闪闪发光。

paragraphs.source_en: Before long, Okabe Tatewaki came again to Genzaburō’s cell. Tatewaki had his men bring in a sumptuous meal with wine and repeatedly praised Genzaburō’s admirable samurai spirit.

units.source_en: Before long, Okabe Tatewaki came again to Genzaburō’s cell.
units.source_zh: 不久，冈部带刀又来到了源三郎的牢里。

units.source_en: Tatewaki had his men bring in a sumptuous meal with wine and repeatedly praised Genzaburō’s admirable samurai spirit.

paragraphs.source_zh: 不久，冈部带刀又来到了源三郎的牢里。带刀让手下做了丰盛的酒饭送了进来，还频频夸奖源三郎的武士精神令人敬佩。

paragraphs.source_en: “Spare me your pretty words. Do I look like a man who would eat your food, drink your wine, listen to your praise, and then betray his convictions?” With a cold laugh, Genzaburō flung aside the food and wine set before him.

units.source_en: “Spare me your pretty words.
units.source_zh: “不要说得那么动听。

units.source_en: Do I look like a man who would eat your food, drink your wine, listen to your praise, and then betray his convictions?”

units.source_en: With a cold laugh, Genzaburō flung aside the food and wine set before him.
units.source_zh: 源三郎冷笑着把端上来的酒菜扔到一边。

paragraphs.source_zh: “不要说得那么动听。你看我是那种吃你的酒菜，听你的褒奖，然后就出卖意志的人吗？”源三郎冷笑着把端上来的酒菜扔到一边。

paragraphs.source_en: In the end, Tatewaki too flew into a humiliated rage. He knotted Genzaburō’s hair, thrust a spear shaft through the knot, hoisted him up, and raced around the cell like a madman. His hair, long since robbed of its resilience, was wrenched out and fell in broken clumps; yet this only heightened Genzaburō’s defiance.

units.source_en: In the end, Tatewaki too flew into a humiliated rage. He knotted Genzaburō’s hair, thrust a spear shaft through the knot, hoisted him up, and raced around the cell like a madman.

units.source_en: His hair, long since robbed of its resilience, was wrenched out and fell in broken clumps; yet this only heightened Genzaburō’s defiance.

paragraphs.source_en: After Kahei likewise fled in disarray, Genzaburō laughed heartily once more. “Ah, what an enormous gulf there is between a man prepared for death and a fellow who is not!”

units.source_en: After Kahei likewise fled in disarray, Genzaburō laughed heartily once more.

units.source_en: From the end of Tenshō 8 into the spring of Tenshō 9, the faint smell of gunpowder began to seep through the air vent, and even the whistle of arrows could be heard.

paragraphs.source_en: Outside, it seemed, March had already arrived. All that day Genzaburō waited for Sakuzō to come, but the entire day passed without Sakuzō showing his face even once.

units.source_en: Outside, it seemed, March had already arrived.

paragraphs.source_en: “Th-that must be the song of a bush warbler.”

paragraphs.source_en: This was enough… His fiercely combative spirit, too, seemed to have found immense satisfaction. He no longer felt the hunger in his belly. Around noon, drowsiness overcame him, and he fell asleep again.

units.source_en: This was enough… His fiercely combative spirit, too, seemed to have found immense satisfaction.
units.source_zh: 这样已经足够了……他那极富战斗力的灵魂似也得到了莫大的满足。

paragraphs.source_en: “If they have entered the castle…” A great wave suddenly surged through Genzaburō’s heart. Even if his lord had entered the castle, he could hardly know at once that a dungeon lay in such a place, with such a samurai imprisoned within it. After finally living to welcome his lord, must he die without ever seeing him?

units.source_en: Suddenly, Genzaburō bowed deeply to the rice ball in Sakuzō’s hand, then raked at it with hands ulcerated and swollen like clubs and began devouring it in great mouthfuls.
units.source_zh: 突然，源三郎向作藏手中的饭团子深施一礼，然后用他那已溃烂成棒槌状的手扒拉着，大口大口地吃了起来。

paragraphs.source_zh: “主公竟然允许人给敌人唱歌？”突然，源三郎向作藏手中的饭团子深施一礼，然后用他那已溃烂成棒槌状的手扒拉着，大口大口地吃了起来。

paragraphs.source_en: Takatenjin Castle had not yet fallen. But it seemed that Takeda Katsuyori’s reinforcements would not come, and every officer and soldier in the castle had prepared to perish with it. Where, then, was Katsuyori now trying to halt the Tokugawa advance?

units.source_en: Takatenjin Castle had not yet fallen.
units.source_zh: 高天神城还没有陷落。

units.source_en: But it seemed that Takeda Katsuyori’s reinforcements would not come, and every officer and soldier in the castle had prepared to perish with it.
units.source_zh: 可是，武田胜赖的援军似乎不来了，全城的官兵都作好了与城池同归于尽的准备。

units.source_en: Where, then, was Katsuyori now trying to halt the Tokugawa advance?
units.source_zh: 那么，现在胜赖到底在哪里阻止德川的进军呢？

paragraphs.source_zh: 高天神城还没有陷落。可是，武田胜赖的援军似乎不来了，全城的官兵都作好了与城池同归于尽的准备。那么，现在胜赖到底在哪里阻止德川的进军呢？

paragraphs.source_en: Ōkōchi Genzaburō finished the rice ball in Sakuzō’s hand, drank every last drop of water from the bamboo flask, and then asked with keen interest about the song.

units.source_en: Ōkōchi Genzaburō finished the rice ball in Sakuzō’s hand, drank every last drop of water from the bamboo flask, and then asked with keen interest about the song.
units.source_zh: 大河内源三郎吃完作藏手中的饭团，把竹筒里剩下的水喝得一滴不剩，又饶有兴味地问起歌谣的事来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大河内源三郎吃完作藏手中的饭团，把竹筒里剩下的水喝得一滴不剩，又饶有兴味地问起歌谣的事来。

paragraphs.source_en: “The soldiers in the castle may die at any moment now, so they pleaded desperately. The tayū performed one piece as a remembrance for them in this life.”

units.source_en: “The soldiers in the castle may die at any moment now, so they pleaded desperately. The tayū performed one piece as a remembrance for them in this life.”
units.source_zh: “现在城里士兵的性命朝不保夕，因此极力地哀求，太夫就唱了一出，作为这些人今生的纪念。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “现在城里士兵的性命朝不保夕，因此极力地哀求，太夫就唱了一出，作为这些人今生的纪念。”

paragraphs.source_en: Sakuzō did not know.

units.source_en: Sakuzō did not know.
units.source_zh: 作藏不知。

paragraphs.source_zh: 作藏不知。

paragraphs.source_en: When a person faces death, a poetic sorrow wells up within the heart. A new strength suddenly arose in Genzaburō’s heart.

units.source_en: When a person faces death, a poetic sorrow wells up within the heart.
units.source_zh: 当一个人面临死亡的时候，心中都会涌起悲凉的诗一般的感觉来。

units.source_en: A new strength suddenly arose in Genzaburō’s heart.
units.source_zh: 源三郎的心里突然产生一种新的力量。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当一个人面临死亡的时候，心中都会涌起悲凉的诗一般的感觉来。源三郎的心里突然产生一种新的力量。

paragraphs.source_en: Sakuzō had no intention of leaving the cell either. The lingering strains of “Taka-dachi,” performed moments before between the opposing battle lines, seemed still to hang in the air, and he remained immersed in deep emotion. Before long, Genzaburō drifted into a fitful doze again. When he awoke again, noise was everywhere around the cell, as though a mountain had collapsed.

units.source_en: Sakuzō had no intention of leaving the cell either.

ja.t: てゆくつもりはなかった。

units.source_zh: 作藏也没打算从牢房里出去。

units.source_en: The lingering strains of “Taka-dachi,” performed moments before between the opposing battle lines, seemed still to hang in the air, and he remained immersed in deep emotion.
units.source_zh: 似乎刚才在双方阵前演唱的《高馆》余音绕梁，他还沉浸在深深的感慨之中。

units.source_en: Before long, Genzaburō drifted into a fitful doze again.

ja.t: びうとうととまどろみ

units.source_zh: 不久，源三郎又迷迷糊糊地打起盹来。

units.source_en: When he awoke again, noise was everywhere around the cell, as though a mountain had collapsed.
units.source_zh: 当他再次醒来，牢房周围像是大山倒塌了，到处是噪音。

paragraphs.source_zh: 作藏也没打算从牢房里出去。似乎刚才在双方阵前演唱的《高馆》余音绕梁，他还沉浸在深深的感慨之中。不久，源三郎又迷迷糊糊地打起盹来。当他再次醒来，牢房周围像是大山倒塌了，到处是噪音。

paragraphs.source_en: The soldiers in the castle must have charged out before dawn; the final assault had begun. The deafening thunder of war drums, the reports of guns, the hiss of arrows, the neighing and agonized cries of horses, the shouts of the warriors—the great battle outside came vividly through that tiny air vent.

units.source_en: The soldiers in the castle must have charged out before dawn; the final assault had begun.
units.source_zh: 一定是天还未亮，城里的士兵就杀了出去，总攻已经开始。

units.source_en: The deafening thunder of war drums, the reports of guns, the hiss of arrows, the neighing and agonized cries of horses, the shouts of the warriors—the great battle outside came vividly through that tiny air vent.
units.source_zh: 震耳欲聋的战鼓声、枪声、箭矢声，战马的嘶鸣、悲鸣，士众的喊声，外面的大战，都从这个小小的通气口生动地传了进来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一定是天还未亮，城里的士兵就杀了出去，总攻已经开始。震耳欲聋的战鼓声、枪声、箭矢声，战马的嘶鸣、悲鸣，士众的喊声，外面的大战，都从这个小小的通气口生动地传了进来。

paragraphs.source_en: Ōkōchi Genzaburō hurriedly drew his festering legs together and sat upright. He could not understand why men had to pile corpses into mountains in such a wretched fashion. He understood only one grim fact: nowhere in the world did there exist a power capable of abolishing such a reality. He placed his hands beneath his filthy chin, pressed his palms together, and prayed for Ieyasu’s victory.

units.source_en: Ōkōchi Genzaburō hurriedly drew his festering legs together and sat upright.
units.source_zh: 大河内源三郎急忙并拢糜烂的双腿坐起来。

units.source_en: He could not understand why men had to pile corpses into mountains in such a wretched fashion.
units.source_zh: 究竟为何，人们非要这么悲惨地把尸体堆成山不可，他心里不明白。

units.source_en: He understood only one grim fact: nowhere in the world did there exist a power capable of abolishing such a reality.
units.source_zh: 他只明白一个严峻的事实：消灭此种现实的力量，在世界上任何一个地方都不存在。

units.source_en: He placed his hands beneath his filthy chin, pressed his palms together, and prayed for Ieyasu’s victory.
units.source_zh: 他把手放在脏兮兮的下巴下面，双手合十，为家康的胜利祈祷。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大河内源三郎急忙并拢糜烂的双腿坐起来。究竟为何，人们非要这么悲惨地把尸体堆成山不可，他心里不明白。他只明白一个严峻的事实：消灭此种现实的力量，在世界上任何一个地方都不存在。他把手放在脏兮兮的下巴下面，双手合十，为家康的胜利祈祷。

paragraphs.source_en: The frenzied din continued from morning until noon the next day. Throughout it all, the jailer Sakuzō crouched beside the window bars, ceaselessly praying for the gods’ protection.

units.source_en: The frenzied din continued from morning until noon the next day. Throughout it all, the jailer Sakuzō crouched beside the window bars, ceaselessly praying for the gods’ protection.
units.source_zh: 疯狂的噪音从第二日的早上一直持续到正午时分，其间，牢卒作藏躲在窗格子的旁边，也在不住地求神明保佑。

paragraphs.source_zh: 疯狂的噪音从第二日的早上一直持续到正午时分，其间，牢卒作藏躲在窗格子的旁边，也在不住地求神明保佑。

paragraphs.source_en: The total was 688. With common soldiers, guards, and others added, Takeda casualties were immense, and the surrounding mountains and valleys lay strewn with headless corpses.

units.source_en: The total was 688. With common soldiers, guards, and others added, Takeda casualties were immense, and the surrounding mountains and valleys lay strewn with headless corpses.
units.source_zh: 总计六百八十八人，再加上杂兵、侍卫等，武田死伤数字十分庞大，周围的山谷到处躺满了无头尸体。

paragraphs.source_zh: 总计六百八十八人，再加上杂兵、侍卫等，武田死伤数字十分庞大，周围的山谷到处躺满了无头尸体。

paragraphs.source_en: Silence returned to the surroundings, and the jailer Sakuzō crept trembling out of the tunnel. Genzaburō was still seated there, palms pressed together, continuing his prayer.

units.source_en: Silence returned to the surroundings, and the jailer Sakuzō crept trembling out of the tunnel.
units.source_zh: 四周再次安静下来，牢卒作藏战战兢兢地爬出坑道。

units.source_en: Genzaburō was still seated there, palms pressed together, continuing his prayer.
units.source_zh: 源三郎依然坐在那里，双手合十，继续祈祷。

paragraphs.source_zh: 四周再次安静下来，牢卒作藏战战兢兢地爬出坑道。源三郎依然坐在那里，双手合十，继续祈祷。

paragraphs.source_en: Before long, the footsteps of five or six people approached amid loud laughter and conversation. “They say the prisoner who has spent seven years in confinement is still alive.”

units.source_en: Before long, the footsteps of five or six people approached amid loud laughter and conversation.
units.source_zh: 未几，五六个人的脚步声伴着高声谈笑走了过来。

units.source_en: “They say the prisoner who has spent seven years in confinement is still alive.”
units.source_zh: “听说坐了七年牢的俘虏现在还活着。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 未几，五六个人的脚步声伴着高声谈笑走了过来。“听说坐了七年牢的俘虏现在还活着。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Who is he?”

units.source_en: “Who is he?”
units.source_zh: “谁啊？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “谁啊？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Hurry and lead the way. It is too dark here—bring a light!”

units.source_en: “Hurry and lead the way.
units.source_zh: “快点带路。

units.source_en: It is too dark here—bring a light!”
units.source_zh: 这里太黑了，掌灯！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “快点带路。这里太黑了，掌灯！”

paragraphs.source_en: Hearing the voices, Genzaburō opened his eyes. They were his own men; nothing could have been clearer.

units.source_en: Hearing the voices, Genzaburō opened his eyes.
units.source_zh: 听到声音，源三郎睁开了眼睛。

units.source_en: They were his own men; nothing could have been clearer.
units.source_zh: 一定是自己人，这再明白不过了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 听到声音，源三郎睁开了眼睛。一定是自己人，这再明白不过了。

paragraphs.source_en: “Here he is, inside these window bars.” Sakuzō shouted, as though he had forgotten that he was a Takeda jailer.

units.source_en: “Here he is, inside these window bars.”
units.source_zh: “在这里，就在窗户格子里面。”

units.source_en: Sakuzō shouted, as though he had forgotten that he was a Takeda jailer.
units.source_zh: 作藏大声道，仿佛忘记了自己乃是武田牢卒。

paragraphs.source_zh: “在这里，就在窗户格子里面。”作藏大声道，仿佛忘记了自己乃是武田牢卒。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ōkōchi Genzaburō Masachika…”

paragraphs.source_zh: “大河内源三郎政局……”

paragraphs.source_en: Having said this, Genzaburō sensed only that the men seemed greatly startled; then he lost consciousness.

units.source_en: Having said this, Genzaburō sensed only that the men seemed greatly startled; then he lost consciousness.

ja.t: いたらしいことだけを

units.source_zh: 源三郎说完，只感到对方似乎大吃一惊，然后他就失去了知觉。

paragraphs.source_zh: 源三郎说完，只感到对方似乎大吃一惊，然后他就失去了知觉。

paragraphs.source_en: When he regained consciousness, he discovered that he had been carried before Ieyasu, who sat upon a camp stool. Night had not fully fallen, and the surroundings could still be made out dimly. Yet everything before Genzaburō’s eyes blazed with light, and he could make out nothing clearly.

units.source_en: When he regained consciousness, he discovered that he had been carried before Ieyasu, who sat upon a camp stool.
units.source_zh: 当他再次苏醒过来，发现自己已经被抬到了坐在床几上的家康面前。

units.source_en: Night had not fully fallen, and the surroundings could still be made out dimly.
units.source_zh: 天还未全黑，四周还可以隐隐约约地分辨。

units.source_en: Yet everything before Genzaburō’s eyes blazed with light, and he could make out nothing clearly.
units.source_zh: 可是，源三郎却觉得眼前明晃晃的，什么也看不清楚。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当他再次苏醒过来，发现自己已经被抬到了坐在床几上的家康面前。天还未全黑，四周还可以隐隐约约地分辨。可是，源三郎却觉得眼前明晃晃的，什么也看不清楚。
